interface.signature: minInsAndDel(N: int, M: int, A: List[int], B: List[int]) -> int

preconditions.description: Length of array A is within the specified range.
Length of array B is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**5 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in array A are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= 10**5 for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: All elements in array B are within the specified range.
Length of array A matches the given parameter N.
Length of array B matches the given parameter M.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of insertions and deletions is non-negative.
The result is calculated as the sum of lengths of A and B minus twice the length of their longest common subsequence (LCS).
